question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**of**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given passage is about an old man.
 
• The most appropriate preposition in the given context is '**of**'.
 
• In the given context '**tired** **of**' is** a phrasal verb**.
 
• It means 'no longer wanting something or wanting to do something because you are bored with it or annoyed by it
 
 
• *Example: We were **tired of** waiting for him to call.*
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

Correct Passage:__ *An old man lived in the village. He was one of the most unfortunate people in the world. The whole village was tired **of** him; he was always gloomy, he (3) ____ complained and was always in a bad mood. The (4) _____ he lived, the more vile he was becoming and the more (5) ____ were his words.*
